Sample week · June 2024

This week's dinner plan

Seven nights, sorted. Here's a taste of what Northstar Pantry members received this week. Mix and match — the shopping list works regardless of the order you cook them.

7 dinners 1 shopping list ~45 min avg

Want your own plan? Join the waitlist →

Monday through Sunday

The full week of dinners

Monday

Sheet Pan Lemon-Herb Chicken

Golden-skinned chicken thighs with a bright lemon-garlic marinade, roasted alongside broccoli, cherry tomatoes, and sliced onions until everything caramelizes at the edges. One pan in the oven, the rest of the evening is yours.

35 min One pan Family favorite
Tuesday

Pasta e Fagioli

This Italian bean-and-pasta soup is the kind of thing that tastes like you've been cooking all day — but it comes together in about 30 minutes from pantry staples. Thick, savory, and deeply satisfying on a weeknight.

30 min Pantry staple Vegetarian
Wednesday

Black Bean & Sweet Potato Tacos with Lime Crema

Roasted sweet potatoes with smoky cumin, hearty black beans, pickled red onion, and a quick lime crema over warm corn tortillas. A taco night the whole family can customize at the table.

25 min Vegetarian Build-your-own
Thursday

Skillet Salmon with Garlic Butter Green Beans

Crispy-skinned salmon fillets pan-seared in a cast iron, finished with a butter, garlic, and lemon pan sauce. Served alongside green beans blistered in the same skillet. Twenty minutes, restaurant quality.

20 min Gluten-free High protein
Friday

Homemade Pizza Night

No delivery box required. We include a simple no-knead dough recipe (made Wednesday, rested in the fridge), two sauce options — classic San Marzano and a white garlic base — and a list of topping ideas. Kids pick their half. Parents pick theirs.

Fun night 45 min active Kid-friendly
Saturday

Slow Cooker Beef & Barley Stew

Load the slow cooker before your Saturday morning errands and come home to something that smells incredible. Chuck roast, barley, root vegetables, and a red wine broth — deeply warming and perfect for a lazy evening.

15 min prep Slow cooker Weekend project
Sunday

Simple Roast Chicken with Pan-Dripping Gravy

The crown of the week. A whole bird, well-seasoned, roasted simply. The pan drippings become a quick gravy that elevates plain sides into something memorable. Bonus: the carcass makes Monday's soup stock if you're into that.

1 hr 20 min Classic Beginner-friendly
The list that goes with it

One trip. One list.

Every Northstar Pantry plan comes with a complete shopping list, pre-organized by grocery section. Here's a condensed preview of what this week's list looks like.

Produce

  • Cherry tomatoes
  • Broccoli
  • Sweet potato (2 large)
  • Green beans
  • Yellow onion
  • Lemons (3)
  • Garlic

Protein

  • Chicken thighs (bone-in, 8 pieces)
  • Salmon fillets (4 × 6oz)
  • Chuck roast (2 lbs)
  • Whole chicken (3.5–4 lbs)

Pantry

  • Crushed tomatoes
  • White beans (canned)
  • Black beans (canned)
  • Pearl barley
  • Ditalini pasta
  • Corn tortillas
  • Pizza flour

Dairy & Fridge

  • Sour cream
  • Unsalted butter
  • Parmesan
